_comment: Windows first-logon account claim, scoped BY TAG rather than by device.
The scope is what decides whether machines that don't exist yet are
covered. `joined-node` is self-attested by Enroll-DdsDevice.ps1, and
`auto-provisioned` by `dds-node provision`, so every machine that joins
from here on matches this policy with no republish. Listing device URNs
in `identity_urns` instead would pin the policy to exactly the machines
named, and a machine added later would silently never match.
`claim_subject_urn` is the PERSON (their enrolled identity URN), not the
machine. One directive per person. On each machine they log in to, the
account is created at their first logon — Windows passwords never travel,
so each machine seals its own.
and bump `version` on every republish — the server does not enforce
ordering, so a stale version publishes fine and is then ignored.
display_name: Staff local accounts on every joined Windows machine

local_accounts.description: Created by DDS at first logon
